text.da: Undskyld, kan du sige det igen?
text.en: Sorry, can you say that again?
No, I do not know that.
Okay, we will take the train.
Yes, we will catch the bus.
Do you have a little time?

text.da: Du snakker hurtigt. Lidt langsommere, tak.
text.en: You are talking fast. A little more slowly, please.
Thank you for the lovely gift.
Where is the road to the school?

text.da: Er der en halv kage tilbage?
text.en: Is there half a cake left?

text.da: Der er et menneske i huset.
text.en: There is a person in the house.

text.da: Jeg forstår ikke. Hvad betyder ordet?
text.en: I do not understand. What does the word mean?
Where in the world are we?

text.da: Nej tak, jeg har ikke lyst.
text.en: No thanks, I do not feel like it.
There is life in the house.
Thank you for a good trip.
